en.name: Tahini
en.summary: Tahini is ground sesame seeds and nothing else, which makes it essentially a jar of oil and solids. Unopened it keeps about 1 year from purchase in the cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate it and use within about 3 weeks — the sesame oil in it goes rancid, and that is the whole clock.
en.pantry: An unopened jar keeps about 1 year from purchase in a cool, dark cupboard. Heat and light are what oxidise the sesame oil, so the back of a cupboard is much better than a shelf above the cooker or a sunny worktop. Separation is normal and not a fault: the oil rises and the solids pack down, sometimes so hard that the first stir is a struggle. Store the jar upside down for a day before you open it and the stirring becomes much easier.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 3 weeks. That short window is about rancidity rather than microbes — there is nothing in tahini for bacteria to work on, but sesame oil turns bitter and paint-like surprisingly quickly once air is in the jar. Stir the oil back in thoroughly before refrigerating, so it does not set as a separate layer, and use a clean dry spoon. Cold tahini is stiff; let it stand for a few minutes before you try to work with it.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for tahini, but freezing is a reasonable way to stretch a large jar you cannot use in three weeks, since rancidity slows sharply in the cold. Stir it well, portion it into small sealed containers or an ice-cube tray at −18 °C (0 °F), and thaw a portion at a time. Expect to have to stir it again after thawing; it will separate.
en.thawing: Thaw a portion of frozen tahini in the fridge and stir it thoroughly before use. Do not leave it on the counter to thaw.
spoilage: A bitter, paint-like or crayon-like smell — rancid sesame oil
A sharply bitter taste that was not there when the jar was new
Mould on the surface, which usually means a wet spoon went in
The paste darkened noticeably and gone hard and dry at the surface
tips: Store the jar upside down before opening so the oil redistributes.
Stir the oil fully back in before refrigerating.
Use a clean dry spoon; water is the only route to mould here.
Buy small jars unless you make hummus often — three weeks is short.

faq.q: How long does tahini last once opened?
faq.a: About 3 weeks refrigerated at 4 °C or below. The sesame oil going rancid is what ends it.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of tahini keep?
faq.a: About 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard.
Yes. Oil rising to the top is normal. Stir it thoroughly back in; it is not a sign of spoilage.

faq.q: Why does my tahini taste bitter?
faq.a: Rancid sesame oil, usually from warmth, light or time after opening. A jar that smells of paint or crayons should be discarded.

zh.name: 中東芝麻醬
zh.summary: Tahini 就是純粹磨碎的芝麻，沒有其他成分，本質上是一罐油和固形物。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 3 週內用完——裡面的芝麻油會走油耗，而那就是它全部的時鐘。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐子放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。讓芝麻油氧化的是溫度和光，所以櫥櫃深處遠好過爐台上方的層架或有陽光的檯面。油水分離是正常的，不是瑕疵：油會浮上來、固形物沉在底部，有時硬到第一次攪拌很費力。開罐前先把罐子倒扣一天，攪起來會輕鬆很多。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下，並在大約 3 週內用完。這個短窗口講的是油耗而不是微生物——tahini 裡沒有什麼可以讓細菌利用的東西，但芝麻油在空氣進入罐子後，會出乎意料地快變苦、出現油漆味。冷藏前先把油徹底攪回去，免得它凝成獨立的一層；並使用乾淨乾燥的湯匙。冰過的 tahini 很硬，放幾分鐘再操作比較好。
zh.freezer: Tahini 沒有冷凍期限，但如果一大罐三週內用不完，冷凍是合理的延長方式，因為低溫會大幅減緩油耗。請先攪勻，再分裝到小密封盒或製冰盒放 −18 °C，要用時一次解凍一份。解凍後它會分離，記得再攪一次。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的 tahini 請放冷藏解凍一份，使用前徹底攪勻。不要放在室溫退冰。
spoilage: 有苦味、油漆味或蠟筆味——那是芝麻油走油耗
吃起來明顯發苦，而剛開罐時沒有
表面長霉，通常代表有沾水的湯匙伸進去過
顏色明顯變深，表面又乾又硬
tips: 開罐前把罐子倒扣放著，讓油重新分布。
冷藏前把油徹底攪回醬裡。
用乾淨乾燥的湯匙；水是這裡唯一會導致發霉的途徑。
除非常做鷹嘴豆泥，否則請買小罐——三週很短。

faq.q: Tahini 開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 3 週。終結它的是芝麻油走油耗。

faq.q: 未開封的 tahini 可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。

faq.q: 分層的 tahini 還能用嗎？
faq.a: 可以。油浮到上面是正常的，徹底攪回去即可，那不是腐壞的徵兆。
芝麻油走油耗了，通常是溫度、光線或開封後時間造成的。聞起來像油漆或蠟筆的就該丟掉。
